topic: In the What If Usopp never joined, Nami loses her cover story during Arlong Park because she can't fake betraying a crew member who doesn't exist
title: Without Usopp, Nami's Plan Falls Apart
description: In the real timeline, Nami survived Arlong Park by faking she'd turned against Usopp, buying her cover with a deception only Arlong believed. But in a crew without a sniper, that lie never happens. Arlong demands something real instead, and Nami is cornered into a far riskier bluff that barely holds.
comment: Does Nami's riskier bluff even work without Usopp to blame, or does Arlong see through it instantly?

lines.text: In the real timeline, Nami fakes betraying Usopp to prove her loyalty to Arlong.
She hurts her own hand and claims it was Usopp who did it, convincing Arlong she's truly loyal without betraying the crew.

shot.search: Nami hurts hand blames Usopp trick

lines.text: But in a crew without a sniper, there's no Usopp to fake. Arlong doesn't believe the lie.

shot.fallback: convenient target nowhere to be found

lines.text: He demands something real instead: proof that these crew members are just random trespassers, nothing more.
Nami is cornered into a far more dangerous bluff with no backup scapegoat and no safety net.
That bluff barely holds. Arlong lets it go only because something bigger arrived from the coast.

shot.fallback: fragile lie surviving by pure luck

lines.text: In a What If where Usopp never joined, the crew survives Arlong Park but on thinner margins.
Every safety net Usopp provided was something Nami and the others had to improvise around instead...

shot.search: Usopp safety net missing backup plan

self_check.hook: line 1 establishes the real timeline (Nami fakes betrayal), line 3 pivots to the What If (no Usopp to blame), line 4 shows the consequence (Arlong demands real proof)
self_check.loop: last line returns to Usopp's role as a safety net without exact repetition
